news.title: 马克龙就地缘政治形势等议题与法国各主要党派代表会谈
news.summary: 中新社巴黎9月18日电 (记者 李洋)法国总统马克龙当地时间18日就地缘政治形势等议题与各主要党派代表举行会谈。

news.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
news.summary: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

news.title: Watch: Trump says ban on some news outlets is 'because they're fake news'
news.summary: The US president on Friday announced he is "immediately" banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House.

news.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
news.summary: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

news.title: Is the Kennedy Center losing 'hundreds of millions of dollars'?
news.summary: Records in 2024 show the venue had a surplus of millions of dollars once contributions and grants had been factored in.

news.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
news.summary: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

news.title: North Korean anthem played for South Korea at Asian Games
news.summary: Organisers have apologised for playing the North Korean national anthem for the South Korean men's hockey team at the Asian Games in Japan.

news.title: Warren Buffett steps down after six decades at Berkshire - 'Father Time always wins'
news.summary: Since taking control in 1965, Buffett grew a struggling textile mill into a global conglomerate.

news.title: Ryanair boss Michael O'Leary apologises over 'high-fare rapists' remarks
news.summary: O'Leary described his choice of language as "careless" and said "it won't happen again".

news.title: 安理会完成联合国秘书长遴选第三轮意向性投票
news.summary: 当地时间9月18日，安理会当月轮值主席、法国常驻联合国代表杰罗姆·博纳丰宣布，安理会当日已就下一任秘书长遴选完成第三轮意向性投票。意向性投票结果不对外公布，将通过候选人推举国通知各候选人。

news.title: 国际原子能机构称俄罗斯一核电站冷却塔被无人机击中
news.summary: 国际原子能机构18日表示，已获悉俄罗斯库尔斯克核电站一个反应堆机组的冷却塔于17日被无人机击中。
